title: On the Identifiability of Hybrid Deep Generative Models: Meta-Learning as a Solution
abstract: arXiv:2610.32748v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The interest in leveraging physics-based inductive bias in deep learning has resulted in recent development of hybrid deep generative models (hybrid-DGMs) that integrate known physics-based mathematical expressions in neural generative models. To identify these hybrid-DGMs requires inferring parameters of the physics-based component along with their neural component. The identifiability of these hybrid-DGMs, however, has not yet been theoretically probed or established. How does the existing theory of the un-identifiability of general DGMs apply to hybrid-DGMs? What may be an effective approach to construct a hybrid-DGM with theoretically-proven identifiability? translated_title: 论混合深度生成模型的可辨识性：元学习作为解决方案
translated_abstract: 在深度学习中利用基于物理的归纳偏置的研究兴趣，推动了混合深度生成模型（hybrid-DGMs）的最新发展，这类模型将已知的基于物理的数学表达式集成到神经生成模型中。识别这些混合深度生成模型需要同时推断基于物理组件的参数以及神经组件的参数。然而，这些混合深度生成模型的可辨识性尚未在理论上得到探究或证实。现有关于一般深度生成模型不可辨识性的理论如何适用于混合深度生成模型？什么可能是构建具有理论可辨识性证明的混合深度生成模型的有效方法？本文首次对混合深度生成模型的可辨识性进行了理论探究，并提出元学习作为构建可辨识混合深度生成模型的一种新颖解决方案。在合成数据和真实数据基准上，我们为混合深度生成模型的不可辨识性提供了强有力的实证证据。
tldr: 本文首次从理论上探究了融合物理知识的混合深度生成模型的可辨识性问题，并提出元学习作为构建具有可辨识性保证的混合深度生成模型的新颖解决方案。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first theoretical probe into the identifiability of hybrid deep generative models (hybrid-DGMs) and presents meta-learning as a novel solution to construct identifiable hybrid-DGMs.
